description: This file is a CMake script used to find and configure the curl library within a build system.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Finds and loads configuration for the specified package, in this case, PkgConfig.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Searches for the specified library file in the system.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a variable, in this case, configuring the path to the curl library.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced to control their visibility in GUIs.

calls: set(CURL_LIBRARY ${CURL_LIBRARY} CACHE PATH "Path to curl library")
